result.summary: The page is generally usable, but there are visible clipping/truncation problems in horizontally scrolling restaurant sections and a few minor content/accessibility concerns.

issues.description: Items on the right edge are cut off: the third 'Fastest near you' card is partially outside the viewport and the restaurant name appears truncated as 'Trattoria Piccol...'.
issues.suggestion: Add clearer horizontal-scroll affordance, adjust card widths/margins, or ensure text truncates gracefully with ellipsis instead of being clipped by the screen edge.

issues.description: A '-100%' badge is shown on the lower popular item, which reads as an unrealistic or broken discount value.
issues.suggestion: Verify the promotion data and display a valid discount label such as '-10%', 'Free delivery', or remove the badge if incorrect.

issues.description: Favorite heart icons and the notification bell are icon-only controls with no visible labels or state indication in the UI.
issues.suggestion: Provide accessible labels such as 'Save Tokumaru Ramen Bar' and 'Notifications', and make selected/favorite state visually and programmatically clear.
